accounts.name: What changed and why it matters

queue.body:
$VTRS sits 6.7% above 16.1, the price where the most shares changed hands in six months.
The entire range since spring is 15.5 to 17.6.
Entry 16.9, target 20.
Below 14.9 the shelf is gone.

Jobless claims averaging 203k a week this month, 10.7% below a year ago.
GDPNow tracking 5.1% growth this quarter.
Median CPI at 2.1%.
The labor market is tight, growth is firming, and inflation is tame. The soft landing is the print.
$COHU held its 30-week average at 47.8 twice in three years. Second test, second hold.
$GLW sitting 7.5% above 144, where the last six months of volume traded.

queue.headline: $QCOM just lined up a pattern we track.
queue.body: Across every name we test it on, this combination has resolved higher 74% of the time about a month out over its full tested history, over 395 occurrences universe-wide, not this one name. A measured tendency on a study split, not our trading record. Chart below.
